execution.progress: The job survives disposable cursor interruption. Remaining inspection rounds, exact plot, exposure and paid effort are retained; explicit cancel/death settles the lock once.

details.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
details.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.

execution.progress: One examination plus two paid work rounds; exact surface, root provenance, reservation, job ID, remaining work and prior payments persist.

details.costs: Study1 round/0.2 energy. Examine(preparedSurfaceId) costs1 round/0.5 energy. Plant additionally requires personal root-planting-trial mastery; its first round examines and reserves one unspoiled root, followed by two1-energy work rounds. This version is bound to Lin, surface-21-lin-113 and owned root item-3-lin-12. Valid visible access within0.65 plus body radius is required. Resume/cancel need exact processId. No other inputs supplied.
details.effects: Checks real cover, residue extents, people, obstacles, reservations, ground matter and access. The clear non-solid annotation alone is not matter. Live conflicts pause before further payment. Exact root escrow and paid progress persist; cancel/death releases surviving unplanted root on the actual worksite ground once, never remote inventory. Successful commitment links the existing surface to one actual trial plot; completed placement cannot be cancelled into food. Existing ageing continues. No propagation, growth, harvest, fertility, free soil removal, food output, maintenance, reward or viability guarantee. Private dated evidence only; the30-round observation remains inconclusive.
